title: VCO
text: Model voltage controlled oscillator, 1 input, 1 output; {Specify using} defines how VCO output frequency is specified Voltage, {Voltage sensitivity (Hz/V)} sets the measure of change in output frequency of VCO, {Free running frequency (Hz)} sets the vCO output frequency without control voltage, {Control voltage (V)} controls voltage values, {Output frequency (Hz)} sets the vCO output frequency values, {Output amplitude (V)} sets the maximum amplitude of the VCO output, {Enable increased buffer size}, {Buffer size} sets the number of samples of the input buffering available during, {Add phase noise}, {Phase noise frequency offset (Hz)} sets the frequency offsets of phase noise from carrier frequency and {Phase noise level (dBc/Hz)} sets the phase noise power at specified frequency offsets relative to the carrier. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: vctrl
ports.summary: Voltage used to control VCO output frequency scalar | vector

ports.name: vco out
ports.summary: Output square wave signal determined by vctrl port scalar

params.name: Specify using
params.values: Define how VCO output frequency is specified Voltage sensitivity (default) | Output frequency vs. control voltage

params.name: Voltage sensitivity (Hz/V)
params.values: Measure of change in output frequency of VCO 100e6 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Free running frequency (Hz)
params.values: VCO output frequency without control voltage 2.5e9 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Control voltage (V)
params.values: Control voltage values [-5 0 5] (default) | real valued vector

params.name: Output frequency (Hz)
params.values: VCO output frequency values [2e9 2.5e9 3e9] (default) | positive real valued vector

params.name: Output amplitude (V)
params.values: Maximum amplitude of the VCO output voltage 1 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Enable increased buffer size
params.values: Enable increased buffer size off (default) | on

params.name: Buffer size
params.values: Number of samples of the input buffering available during simulation 10 (default) | positive integer scalar

params.name: Add phase noise
params.values: Add phase noise as a function of frequency on (default) | off

params.name: Phase noise frequency offset (Hz)
params.values: Frequency offsets of phase noise from carrier frequency [10e3 100e3 1e6 3e6 10e6] (default) | positive real valued vector

params.name: Phase noise level (dBc/Hz)
params.values: Phase noise power at specified frequency offsets relative to the carrier [-77 -108 -134 -145 -154] (default) | negative real valued vector
